checks.evidence: LoadClosedAssetState calls CopyRates(symbol, PERIOD_D1, 1, HISTORY_BUFFER, rates).
iTime shift 0 supplies only the known close boundary of rates[0]; no shift-zero OHLC value enters signal or volatility.
The first completed close_time <= decision_time - 31536000 seconds is selected without future access.
Signal, volatility, weights and target volumes are prepared once and retained across transition retries.
BTC eligibility is a compile-time 2018-05-14 UTC listing/warmup boundary, independent of results.
The EA has no indicator handles, CopyBuffer calls, ZigZag/fractal pivots, centered windows or future-bar references.
Any missing active asset invalidates the whole snapshot; no source-missing leg is assigned a result-dependent zero weight.
NormalizeVolumeNearest retains the sign of target-current after rounding absolute lots, so short opens and same-side reductions are executable.
A forced post-rebalance financing snapshot supersedes the earlier daily-open snapshot for the same calendar day; the frozen analyzer carries the last state across no-tick days.

limitations: Static audit does not prove imported custom-symbol coverage or runtime execution correctness.
